annotations.title: Search the logs of many deployments at once

description: Search the container and crash logs of running deployments of an application (and version) for a pattern, and group the matching lines by error, with counts and which deployments printed them: "every crash in version 1.4.2 since yesterday, grouped by error". Without a pattern it looks for errors, exceptions, fatal signals and out-of-memory kills. Also counts crash exit codes. Logs only exist while a deployment runs (or in Endpoint Storage), so stopped deployments are not searched. Searches up to 100 deployments per call, newest first. Read-only.

max_groups.description: Most error groups to return, 1-50. Default 15.

pattern.description: Text to find, case-insensitive. Default: common error and crash words.

regex.description: Treat pattern as a regular expression. Default false.

started_after.description: Only deployments started after this ISO 8601 time, e.g. "2026-11-12T00:00:00Z" for the last day.

name: edgegap_search_deployment_logs
title: Search the logs of many deployments at once
